meta.purpose: Machine-readable routing table for the deterministic routing-evaluator (TL-ROUTE). Same signals in -> same candidates out. Emits indicators, never verdicts.
meta.note: The evaluator matches ALREADY-EXTRACTED structured signals. It never interprets natural language. The 'intent' constraint is matched against the caller-supplied intent-hint.
meta.attestation: no source prose copied; no card ids in public files

genre.role: selects the review lens and shaping defaults; never inferred by a classifier

depth_mode.role: sets intensity and whether reviewers/orchestrator engage

preservation_intent.role: sets fidelity strictness and voice envelope

task_mode.role: separates reporting from applying from building; usage is correctness-only revise

primary_routes.note: WF-PLAN is plan-only; it stops at a checkable layout and drafts no prose
whole-document authoring end to end (write me a document / draft a full X from these notes / turn this brief into a finished piece); WF-COMPOSE is plan-through-draft, WF-PLAN is plan-only
grouping and ordering are subroutines of one activation, not separate skills

primary_routes.then: WF-REVISE or WF-RESTRUCTURE per defect layer

primary_routes.note: lightweight correctness-only path; fidelity stays strict; no claim is changed
audience change with technical precision anchored

primary_routes.requires_note: genre selects shaping defaults; ask when absent, do not infer
genre selects the review lens; ask when absent, do not infer

genre_lens.general_explanatory: reader-comprehension and explanatory-clarity lens, no recommendation to argue

collision_rules.rule: Return all comparable-strength candidates rather than picking one; a collision is 2+ candidates sharing the top match strength.
disambiguation_order: when the defect layer is known, structure defects route to restructure and prose defects route to revise
when depth is unstated, default to standard, never deep
when genre is required for review or shaping and is absent, ASK; do not assume
when still tied, surface the choice to the user

missing_signal_defaults.reader_frame_absent: run SK-FRAME first, the most common clarification trigger
missing_signal_defaults.genre_absent_for_review: ask when genre is absent; do not infer it
missing_signal_defaults.read_mode_absent_for_apparatus: ask whether the document is scanned or linear
missing_signal_defaults.preservation_intent_absent: default strict for technical and academic, standard otherwise

required_signal_ask.genre: ASK: genre required, do not infer

negative_examples.do: route to WF-REVISE for cohesion; escalate to restructure only if diagnosis flags a structural symptom

negative_examples.request: give it a once-over and tell me it is ready to ship
negative_examples.do: a ship decision requires WF-FINALIZE; a quick pass may not masquerade as a quality gate

negative_examples.do_not: drop hedges or qualifiers to hit the length
negative_examples.do: use compress mode under WF-REVISE with the fidelity gate; qualifiers are retained

negative_examples.request: simplify this for a lay reader
negative_examples.do_not: route to SK-REVISE-PROSE for same-reader clarity
negative_examples.do: route to SK-ADAPT for an audience change with technical precision anchored

negative_examples.request: review my draft with genre unstated
negative_examples.do: ask which genre or document type before selecting the review lens

negative_examples.request: cluster these and tell me the order
negative_examples.do_not: create two skills worth of routing
negative_examples.do: SK-ARGUE handles grouping and ordering as one activation

negative_examples.request: the clearest order breaks my logic, which wins
negative_examples.do_not: default to structure wins or prose wins
negative_examples.do: enter the arbitration path; try a both-satisfying rewrite, reject meaning-altering fixes, escalate a genuine unresolved same-passage conflict
